inputs.label: Perfect Dark ROM (NTSC Final)
inputs.help: Your own Perfect Dark (USA, NTSC Final) N64 ROM as .z64. The PAL and Japanese versions do not work.

steps.why: Android creates Android/data/com.perfectdark.port/files on the first launch.
The launcher only starts when this exact file name exists.

steps.text: Open Perfect Dark VR from Library > Unknown Sources.

notes: The guide has the user pick the ROM in the app, which copies it to files/data/pd.ntsc-final.z64; the payload says copying the file there directly works too, which this recipe does. Release assets also include PCVR zips and JPN/PAL APKs (names start with _), which the anchored pattern avoids. v2.0 named the APK Standalone-NTSC, v2.1 Standalone_NTSC, hence [-_].
